status: outside-Assets candidate / CPU validated / not activated or GPU compiled
sourceRegion: External confirmed source-colour region ID plus decision provenance. Material ID, palette-family ordinal and occlusion owner are different identifiers. A confirmed flag is a caller assertion, not semantic proof.

input.source: Original model/image hashes, original material linear factor, primitive/triangle/UV/texel/RGBA witnesses from SourcePalette58.Family/Sample
input.region: ResolvedRegionInput.Region: unique id, confirmed, decisionId, explicit palette-family ordinal
input.stageSample: ResolvedRegionInput.Cell: sourceId, regionId, original source witness, opaqueInterior, integer shade index k
input.shade: Initial Q and final corrected Qprime are separate externally supplied integer indices. The bridge never derives them from RGB or palette spacing.
input.raster: One row-major binding per actual stage raster sample. stagePixel=floor(SV_POSITION.xy), in that target's pixel convention. Initial480/960 and final480 need distinct correctly aligned inputs. No UV reprojection or stage resampling is implemented.
input.uploadABI: uint2 binding=(family,1 iff resolved opaque); uint index=k; uint4 family=(paletteOffset,count,0,0); uint4 palette=(sRGB8,255); uint2 size=(width,height)

output.resolvedInterior: SourceLookup54(family,k) -> existing sRGB8-to-linear transfer; original alpha retained. No RGB*g, factor multiplication, interpolation or medoid recomputation after lookup.
output.initial: BodyPalette302 candidate passes stagePixel to SurfaceLayerOutput335; normal colour view resolves LUT before legacy colour*factor fallback.
output.final: ApplyShadeBoundary candidate resolves LUT before legacy apply, role and old==q gates; factor RGB=1. Existing class metadata copies the legacy Qprime mask, so the future supplier must prove it describes the same supplied k. This live metadata agreement is not yet verified.
output.unresolvedOrExcluded: No invented family/index/colour. Keep original legacy path, count separately, and do not include in finite-palette success.
output.afterLookup: Final finite RGB is guaranteed only at these candidate joins. Later RGB multiplication, LineTone, AA blend or tone mapping can break membership; no full-frame or outline completion is claimed. Debug g/Q views are outside colour-output membership tests.

missingCurrentFaceInputs: Confirmed full-face source region hierarchy that preserves scalp/skin separation and the actual weak cheek stroke/gradient/AA evidence.
Confirmed region-to-family/source-sample bindings; 104 parent8 is not a flat palette family and material ID is not a substitute.
Same-frame primitive/material/UV-to-region raster supplier for each initial/final pass, including opaque interior vs partial/AA boundaries and matching Q/Qprime metadata.
Separate finite outline/partial-alpha and post-LUT colour handling contract.
lifetime: Pure CPU preparation/reference builder, no Unity objects/static history/GPU allocations or default per-frame integration. Returned packet owns its arrays. Rebuild input when source/region decisions change; palette settings do not alter region IDs or Q.
tests: verify_cpu.py uses installed csc.exe and unchanged existing palette54 tests. test_cpu.ps1 was denied by OS script policy before execution; policy unchanged and not retried.
